models_evaluated: Child Abuse Clinical Decision Support (CA-CDS) prototype (NLP-based)

links.outcome: Clinician usability feedback on CDS prototype used to refine design before implementation
links.effect: Interviews with 24 clinicians from 4 EDs yielded themes on design, workflow fit and barriers such as alert fatigue; iterative modifications were made to the prototype based on feedback.
links.quote: On the basis of user feedback, iterative modifications were made to the prototype.

unlisted_practices: Customizing alert content for medical versus nursing providers and initial versus subsequent alert exposure
Soft-stop alert configuration with editable and automatic documentation

screen.reason: Mixed-methods usability study evaluating clinicians' interaction with a novel NLP-based clinical decision support prototype for child abuse detection.
